newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to fight rat invasion on rice lands.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to fight rat invasion on rice lands.

text.p: A team of agriculturists has been dispatched to check a rat invasion on the rice lands of Luzon island in the northern Philippines, the Agriculture Department said on Wednesday.

"Rat infestation in the (October-December) crop season affectd 30,552 hectares in Cagayan Valley and Central Luzon regions but caused damage to an equivalent area of only 1,637 hectares," the department said in a report on rodent infestation.
The Agriculture Department said the damaged area represents a minute 0.16 percent of the 986,096 hectares of planted rice farms in the October to December period.

"Production loss is estimated at 5,440 tonnes or 0.15 percent of the expected national production of 3.5 million tonnes (during the period)," the report said. It said the damaged crop was worth 12.43 million pesos.
The Agriculture department said it has so far controlled 17,589 hectares of the affected area.
But other Agriculture officials said they are now verifying reports of rodent infestation in other rice and sugar farms in the central Visayas island.
"There are many rats now...and for as long as they can eat anything they will remain prolific," crop protection division chief Hilario Bergonia of the Bureau of Plant Industry told reporters.
The Agriculture Department said it has coordinated with local governments and non-government organisations on the distribution of pesticides in the affected areas to destroy the rats.
